text: 7月16日，沪深两市全天成交额合计24035.65亿元。其中，沪市成交额为11242.08亿元；深市成交额为12793.57亿元；创业板成交额为5807.15亿元。
text_en: On July 16, total full-day turnover in Shanghai and Shenzhen两市 was 2403.565 billion yuan. Among this, Shanghai market turnover was 1124.208 billion yuan; Shenzhen market turnover was 1279.357 billion yuan; ChiNext turnover was 580.715 billion yuan.
